ex.en: You have to get this work finished by noon.
ex.zh: 你必須在中午前完成這項工作。

ex.en: The train is due to arrive at noon.
ex.zh: 火車預定中午抵達。

ex.en: Tell him to call me tomorrow at noon.
ex.zh: 叫他明天中午打電話給我。

ex.en: He notified the police of the traffic accident.
ex.zh: 他向警方通報了這起車禍。

ex.en: Please fill out this form and wait for us to notify you.
ex.zh: 請填好這張表格，等候我們通知。

ex.en: If there's a better solution, then I'll notify you about it as soon as possible.
ex.zh: 如果有更好的解決方案，我會盡快通知您。

ex.en: She was nominated for Employee of the Year.
ex.zh: 她被提名為年度最佳員工。

ex.en: The film was nominated for three awards.
ex.zh: 這部電影入圍了三個獎項。

ex.en: Each team should nominate one person to attend the meeting.
ex.zh: 每個團隊應指派一人出席會議。

ex.en: The board nominated Amy as the new director.
ex.zh: 董事會任命 Amy 為新任主管。

ex.en: It's noisy around here, so speak a little louder.
ex.zh: 這裡有點吵，請說大聲一點。

ex.en: It is too noisy around here; I can't concentrate.
ex.zh: 這裡太吵了，我沒辦法專心。

ex.en: Our neighbors are very noisy at night.
ex.zh: 我們的鄰居晚上很吵。

ex.en: The film received five Oscar nominations.
ex.zh: 這部電影獲得五項奧斯卡提名。

ex.en: Nominations for the award close on Friday.
ex.zh: 這個獎項的提名於週五截止。

non.zh: 非、不（多作字首，如 non-profit 非營利）

ex.en: The prefix "non" means "not," as in non-smoking.
ex.zh: 字首「non」表示「非、不」，例如 non-smoking（禁菸）。

ex.en: Add "non" to "profit" and you get non-profit.
ex.zh: 在 profit 前面加上 non，就變成 non-profit（非營利）。

ex.en: He is the nominal head of the company.
ex.zh: 他是公司名義上的負責人。

ex.en: Her role on the board is purely nominal.
ex.zh: 她在董事會的角色純屬名義上的。

ex.en: We charge a nominal fee for delivery.
ex.zh: 我們只收取象徵性的運費。

ex.en: The museum charges a nominal entrance fee.
ex.zh: 博物館只收取少許入場費。

ex.en: Nominal GDP grew by 4 percent.
ex.zh: 名目國內生產毛額成長了百分之四。

ex.en: The nominal interest rate does not include inflation.
ex.zh: 名目利率沒有考慮通膨因素。

ex.en: Prices rose in many areas, notably in Taipei.
ex.zh: 許多地區房價上漲，尤其是台北。

ex.en: Sales were notably higher this year.
ex.zh: 今年的銷售額明顯較高。

ex.en: Each computer is a node in the network.
ex.zh: 每台電腦都是網路中的一個節點。

ex.en: The data is stored on several nodes.
ex.zh: 資料儲存在好幾個節點上。

ex.en: Accepting the other's norms is submitting to the other's power.
ex.zh: 接受對方的規範，就是屈服於對方的權力。

ex.en: Working from home has become the norm.
ex.zh: 在家工作已成為常態。

ex.en: Social norms differ from country to country.
ex.zh: 社會規範因國家而異。

ex.en: Carrefour's Ham offcuts are not expensive at all, but are nonetheless delicious.
ex.zh: 家樂福的火腿邊角料一點都不貴，卻還是很好吃。

ex.en: The task was difficult; nonetheless, we finished on time.
ex.zh: 任務很困難，儘管如此，我們還是準時完成了。

ex.en: It was raining. Nonetheless, the event went ahead.
ex.zh: 當時在下雨，儘管如此，活動還是照常舉行。

notable.zh: 值得注意的、顯著的、著名的

ex.en: There has been a notable increase in online sales.
ex.zh: 網路銷售有顯著的成長。

ex.en: The city is notable for its night markets.
ex.zh: 這座城市以夜市聞名。

ex.en: I do not have an account in these forums.
ex.zh: 我在這些論壇上沒有帳號。

ex.en: I'm not sure about the price.
ex.zh: 我不太確定價格。

ex.en: "Will it rain tomorrow?" "I hope not."
ex.zh: 「明天會下雨嗎？」「希望不會。」

ex.en: If not, please let me know.
ex.zh: 如果不行，請告訴我。

not.zh: not only … but also：不但…而且

ex.en: She is not only smart but also hardworking.
ex.zh: 她不但聰明，而且很努力。

ex.en: The hotel is not only cheap but also clean.
ex.zh: 這家飯店不但便宜，而且很乾淨。

not.zh: not at all：一點也不；（回應道謝）不客氣

ex.en: I'm not at all tired.
ex.zh: 我一點也不累。

ex.en: "Thanks for your help." "Not at all."
ex.zh: 「謝謝你的幫忙。」「不客氣。」

ex.en: I have no more time to talk with you.
ex.zh: 我沒有時間再跟你聊了。

ex.en: There is no milk in the fridge.
ex.zh: 冰箱裡沒有牛奶。

ex.en: No, thank you. I'm full.
ex.zh: 不用了，謝謝，我吃飽了。

ex.en: No, I don't think so.
ex.zh: 不，我不這麼認為。

ex.en: No smoking is allowed in the office.
ex.zh: 辦公室內禁止吸菸。

ex.en: The sign says no parking.
ex.zh: 告示上寫著禁止停車。

ex.en: If I don't do it now, I never will.
ex.zh: 如果我現在不做，就永遠不會做了。

ex.en: My son can count up to a hundred now.
ex.zh: 我兒子現在會數到一百了。

ex.en: It's already eleven o'clock. I must be leaving now.
ex.zh: 已經十一點了，我現在得走了。

ex.en: Start right now, and you'll catch up with them.
ex.zh: 你現在馬上出發，就能趕上他們。

ex.en: I've got my friend on the line right now.
ex.zh: 我現在正在跟朋友講電話。

ex.en: Now that you're here, let's start.
ex.zh: 既然你來了，我們就開始吧。

ex.en: Now that I have a car, I can drive to work.
ex.zh: 既然我有車了，就可以開車上班。

ex.en: This box is empty. It has nothing in it.
ex.zh: 這個箱子是空的，裡面什麼都沒有。

ex.en: As far as I know, he did nothing wrong.
ex.zh: 據我所知，他沒做錯任何事。

ex.en: On entering a dark tunnel, we could see nothing.
ex.zh: 一進入漆黑的隧道，我們什麼都看不見。

ex.en: There was nothing but a desk in his room.
ex.zh: 他房間裡只有一張書桌。

ex.en: He drinks nothing but coffee in the morning.
ex.zh: 他早上只喝咖啡。

nothing.zh: have nothing to do with：與…無關

ex.en: This has nothing to do with you.
ex.zh: 這跟你無關。

ex.en: His decision had nothing to do with money.
ex.zh: 他的決定跟錢沒有關係。

ex.en: I'd like to borrow your notes for a bit.
ex.zh: 我想跟你借一下筆記。

ex.en: I'll keep the meeting notes to review them before the next session.
ex.zh: 我會保留會議筆記，下次開會前再複習。

ex.en: Tom left a note for Mary on her desk.
ex.zh: 湯姆在瑪麗桌上留了一張紙條給她。

ex.en: There was a note on my desk in Tom's handwriting.
ex.zh: 我桌上有一張湯姆手寫的紙條。

ex.en: The students noted down every word the teacher said.
ex.zh: 學生們把老師說的每個字都記了下來。

ex.en: Please note down your order number.
ex.zh: 請記下您的訂單編號。

ex.en: Please note that the office will be closed on Monday.
ex.zh: 請注意，辦公室星期一不開放。

ex.en: Note that prices may change.
ex.zh: 請留意價格可能會變動。

ex.en: Korean food is noted for its spicy flavor.
ex.zh: 韓國菜以辣聞名。

ex.en: The city is noted for its night markets.
ex.zh: 這座城市以夜市聞名。

ex.en: No one noticed her absence until the meeting ended.
ex.zh: 直到會議結束都沒人注意到她不在。

ex.en: Tom didn't notice that Mary had a new hairstyle.
ex.zh: 湯姆沒注意到瑪麗換了新髮型。

ex.en: The store is closed until further notice.
ex.zh: 商店暫停營業，直到另行通知。

ex.en: Tom gave his two weeks' notice yesterday.
ex.zh: 湯姆昨天提出兩週後離職的通知。

ex.en: Please read the notice on the board.
ex.zh: 請看公布欄上的公告。

ex.en: A notice was posted at the entrance.
ex.zh: 入口處貼了一張公告。

ex.en: She took no notice of what her father said.
ex.zh: 她完全不理會父親說的話。

ex.en: He never takes any notice of what his father says.
ex.zh: 他從不理會父親說的話。

ex.en: Traffic conditions on the highway are normal this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上高速公路的交通狀況正常。

ex.en: It's normal to be a little afraid.
ex.zh: 有點害怕很正常。

ex.en: He's just a normal junior high school student, not particularly intelligent.
ex.zh: 他只是個普通的國中生，不算特別聰明。

ex.en: The man's body temperature is higher than normal.
ex.zh: 這個男人的體溫比正常高。

ex.en: Things will soon return to normal.
ex.zh: 情況很快就會恢復正常。

ex.en: None of them would admit to being the culprit.
ex.zh: 他們沒有一個人承認自己是犯人。

ex.en: None of them could understand what she was implying.
ex.zh: 他們沒有人聽懂她在暗示什麼。

ex.en: None of the rooms were available.
ex.zh: 沒有任何空房。

none.zh: none of your business：不關你的事

ex.en: In any case, it's none of your business.
ex.zh: 總之，這不關你的事。

ex.en: Where I go is none of your business.
ex.zh: 我去哪裡不關你的事。

none.zh: second to none：首屈一指、不輸任何人

ex.en: Yamada is second to none in English in his class.
ex.zh: 山田的英文在班上首屈一指。

ex.en: Their customer service is second to none.
ex.zh: 他們的客戶服務首屈一指。

ex.en: Tom meant it as a joke, but nobody laughed.
ex.zh: 湯姆只是開玩笑，但沒有人笑。

ex.en: Nobody had the courage to say it to him.
ex.zh: 沒有人有勇氣跟他說。

ex.en: Nobody can prevent this plan from being carried out.
ex.zh: 沒有人能阻止這個計畫執行。

ex.en: Ten years ago, he was a nobody in the music business.
ex.zh: 十年前他在音樂界還是個無名小卒。

ex.en: She went from a nobody to a famous actress.
ex.zh: 她從無名小卒變成知名女演員。

ex.en: Canada is to the north of the United States.
ex.zh: 加拿大位於美國北方。

ex.en: There was a cold wind blowing from the north.
ex.zh: 一陣冷風從北方吹來。

ex.en: Keelung is in the north of Taiwan.
ex.zh: 基隆在台灣北部。

ex.en: To reach the North Pole is not easy.
ex.zh: 要抵達北極並不容易。

ex.en: Canada is on the north side of America.
ex.zh: 加拿大在美國的北邊。

ex.en: The road runs north along the coast.
ex.zh: 這條路沿著海岸往北延伸。

ex.en: We drove north to Taichung.
ex.zh: 我們往北開到台中。

ex.en: This novel is too difficult for me to read.
ex.zh: 這本小說對我來說太難讀了。

ex.en: I spent the whole day in reading the novel.
ex.zh: 我花了一整天看這本小說。

ex.en: My brother would often stay up all night reading novels.
ex.zh: 我哥哥常常熬夜看小說。

ex.en: That's a novel idea!
ex.zh: 那是個新奇的點子！

ex.en: The company took a novel approach to marketing.
ex.zh: 這家公司採用了新穎的行銷方式。

ex.en: Normally, I stay at home on Sundays.
ex.zh: 我星期天通常待在家。

ex.en: A sentence normally has a subject and a verb.
ex.zh: 一個句子通常有主詞和動詞。

ex.en: Normally I might study Chinese characters for an hour a day.
ex.zh: 我平常每天大概練一個小時的漢字。

ex.en: The system is working normally again.
ex.zh: 系統已恢復正常運作。

ex.en: Try to breathe normally.
ex.zh: 盡量正常呼吸。

ex.en: I can't put up with that noise any longer.
ex.zh: 我再也受不了那個噪音了。

ex.en: Noises interfered with my studying.
ex.zh: 噪音干擾了我讀書。

ex.en: It's not possible to study with so much noise!
ex.zh: 這麼吵根本沒辦法讀書！

ex.en: I have no notion of how this machine works.
ex.zh: 我完全不知道這台機器是怎麼運作的。

ex.en: The notion that money buys happiness is wrong.
ex.zh: 認為金錢能買到快樂的觀念是錯的。

ex.en: He rejected the notion of working overtime.
ex.zh: 他不接受加班的想法。

ex.en: The city is at the northern end of Japan.
ex.zh: 這座城市位於日本的最北端。

ex.en: Japan is located in the Northern Hemisphere.
ex.zh: 日本位於北半球。

ex.en: Norway, located in Northern Europe, is a highly developed country.
ex.zh: 挪威位於北歐，是高度發展的國家。

ex.en: She pressed her nose against the sheet of glass.
ex.zh: 她把鼻子貼在玻璃上。

ex.en: Your noses are bleeding.
ex.zh: 你們的鼻子在流血。

ex.en: I have a cold and my nose is running.
ex.zh: 我感冒了，一直流鼻水。

nose.zh: poke one's nose into：多管閒事、干涉

ex.en: My father is always poking his nose into my private life.
ex.zh: 我爸總是干涉我的私生活。

ex.en: Stop poking your nose into my business.
ex.zh: 別再管我的事了。

ex.en: Nowadays many people travel by car.
ex.zh: 現在很多人開車旅行。

ex.en: Nowadays, almost every home has one or two televisions.
ex.zh: 現在幾乎每個家庭都有一兩台電視。

ex.en: Without an air conditioner, people nowadays cannot live.
ex.zh: 現在的人沒有冷氣就活不下去。

ex.en: He said he had nowhere to go.
ex.zh: 他說他無處可去。

ex.en: My keys are nowhere to be found.
ex.zh: 我的鑰匙怎麼找都找不到。

ex.en: After three hours of discussion we got nowhere.
ex.zh: 我們討論了三個小時，卻毫無進展。

ex.en: Prolonging the discussion will bring us nowhere.
ex.zh: 繼續討論下去也不會有結果。

nowhere.zh: in the middle of nowhere：在偏僻荒涼的地方

ex.en: I live in the middle of nowhere.
ex.zh: 我住在一個很偏僻的地方。

ex.en: Our car broke down in the middle of nowhere.
ex.zh: 我們的車在荒郊野外拋錨了。

ex.en: In this case, the adjective goes before the noun.
ex.zh: 在這種情況下，形容詞放在名詞前面。

ex.en: Is this word a noun or a verb?
ex.zh: 這個字是名詞還是動詞？

ex.en: Adjectives describe nouns.
ex.zh: 形容詞用來修飾名詞。

ex.en: It was a noble decision to donate the money.
ex.zh: 捐出這筆錢是個高尚的決定。

ex.en: Helping others is a noble goal.
ex.zh: 幫助別人是崇高的目標。

ex.en: Your sister looks as noble as if she were a princess.
ex.zh: 你妹妹看起來好高貴，就像公主一樣。

ex.en: She comes from a noble family.
ex.zh: 她出身貴族世家。

ex.en: Generally speaking, nobles were only very slightly affected by taxes.
ex.zh: 整體來說，貴族受稅賦的影響非常小。

ex.en: The castle once belonged to a wealthy noble.
ex.zh: 這座城堡曾屬於一位富有的貴族。

ex.en: The relationship between price and demand is nonlinear.
ex.zh: 價格和需求之間是非線性的關係。

ex.en: This software supports nonlinear video editing.
ex.zh: 這套軟體支援非線性影片剪輯。

ex.en: Musical notation can be hard to learn.
ex.zh: 樂譜記號可能很難學。

ex.en: Scientific notation makes large numbers easier to write.
ex.zh: 科學記號讓很大的數字更容易書寫。

ex.en: When it comes to love, women are experts and men eternal novices.
ex.zh: 說到愛情，女人是專家，男人永遠是新手。

ex.en: This course is designed for novices.
ex.zh: 這門課是為初學者設計的。

ex.en: As a novice, I made many mistakes in my first week.
ex.zh: 身為新手，我第一週犯了很多錯。

ex.en: I have a friend whose father is a famous novelist.
ex.zh: 我有個朋友，他的父親是知名小說家。

ex.en: He is not a poet but a novelist.
ex.zh: 他不是詩人，而是小說家。

ex.en: My friend's father is a famous novelist.
ex.zh: 我朋友的父親是一位有名的小說家。

ex.en: He prefers nonfiction, especially books about history.
ex.zh: 他比較喜歡非小說類的書，尤其是歷史書。

ex.en: The library has separate shelves for fiction and nonfiction.
ex.zh: 圖書館的小說和非小說類書籍分開擺放。

ex.en: This junction is notorious for accidents.
ex.zh: 這個路口因頻繁的事故而臭名昭著。

ex.en: Ms. Eichler had a notorious reputation for being austere to her students.
ex.zh: 艾希勒女士對學生嚴厲是出了名的。

ex.en: The old photographs filled him with nostalgia.
ex.zh: 那些老照片讓他充滿懷舊之情。

ex.en: She felt a wave of nostalgia for her school days.
ex.zh: 她對學生時代湧起一陣懷念之情。

ex.en: The truth and simplicity of nature is always the most important foundation of noteworthy art.
ex.zh: 大自然的真實和質樸往往是值得注意的藝術中最重要的基石。

ex.en: Her most noteworthy achievement was doubling the company's sales.
ex.zh: 她最值得一提的成就是讓公司的銷售額翻倍。

ex.en: Nothing noteworthy happened at the meeting.
ex.zh: 這次會議沒有發生什麼值得注意的事。

ex.en: I didn't mean to be nosy.
ex.zh: 我沒想多管閒事。

ex.en: My nosy neighbor always asks who comes to visit our house.
ex.zh: 我那個愛打聽的鄰居總是問誰來我們家拜訪。

ex.en: There are noticeable differences between the two.
ex.zh: 兩者之間有顯著的差別。

ex.en: There was a noticeable change in his attitude after the trip.
ex.zh: 那趟旅行之後，他的態度有了明顯的轉變。

ex.en: Her English has improved in a very noticeable way.
ex.zh: 她的英文進步得非常明顯。

ex.en: In the past, only the nobility could afford such fine clothes.
ex.zh: 過去只有貴族才買得起這麼高級的衣服。

ex.en: The king invited members of the nobility to the royal wedding.
ex.zh: 國王邀請貴族們參加皇室婚禮。

ex.en: Everyone admired the nobility of her decision to forgive him.
ex.zh: 大家都很欽佩她決定原諒他的高尚情操。

ex.en: There is a quiet nobility in helping others without asking for thanks.
ex.zh: 默默幫助別人而不求回報，是一種高尚的品格。

ex.en: You need to have the contract notarized.
ex.zh: 你需要把合約拿去公證。

ex.en: The documents were notarized by a lawyer.
ex.zh: 這些文件經過律師公證。

ex.en: You will receive a notification when the order ships.
ex.zh: 訂單出貨時您會收到通知。

ex.en: The system sent a notification to all staff.
ex.zh: 系統已向所有員工發出通知。

ex.en: Each nominee for the director role was interviewed by the board.
ex.zh: 董事會面試了每一位主管職位的提名人選。

ex.en: The award nominee was notified before the public announcement.
ex.zh: 獎項入圍者在公開宣布前就接到了通知。

ex.en: Her notice period ends at the end of the month.
ex.zh: 她的離職預告期在月底結束。

ex.en: Please confirm the required notice period with human resources.
ex.zh: 請向人資確認所需的預告期間。

ex.en: Are we making a nonstop flight to the U.S.?
ex.zh: 我們搭的是直飛美國的航班嗎？

ex.en: After a nonstop shift, the nurses took turns resting.
ex.zh: 連續值班後，護理師輪流休息。
